title: Whole-site factual and date audit

routePartition.method: Canonical place and attributed-source inventory; retained individual source dates, not a fresh check of every officeholder.
Structured main-body claim screening, with selected primary-source verification.
Static text/date/count scan and selected current-office, chamber and timetable checks.
Local route family and retained scoped election, candidate, album and implementation evidence; not all local factual claims reverified.

partitionNote: These route groups partition the 2,291 public routes; canonical place records and registered acceptance contracts are different units. Counts do not measure factual verification.

meanings.implementation: Dated change or implementation evidence for the stated page or feature.
meanings.sourceCheck: Only the stated source or claim was checked; observation period remains separate.
meanings.event: Election/deadline itself, with jurisdiction timezone and confirmation status.
meanings.technicalValidation: The named structural/runtime tests, not factual certification.
meanings.publication: Exact deployed commit and stated live checks, independent of local preparation.

dates.changedNationalImplementationScope: Actually changed national HTML, including same-layer maps embedding changed clocks, receives scoped implementation dates; source dates remain unchanged.

corrections.summary: Resolve 87 baseline rendered footer/register discrepancies. Where actual scoped clock/content changes also occurred, implementation dates advance with those changes; source verification dates do not.
Baseline 115 unregistered routes reduced to 107: eight actually edited routes gain targeted implementation records, not blanket fresh dates.

Reconcile About candidate summary; mark elapsed AI and Closing the Gap consultation windows; update gas scheme timing; qualify AEC membership requirement; describe checkout as disabled proposal; correct treaty database scope and mark historical count unverified.
Constitution pages distinguish state/territory source-record reviews from full constitutional reviews; preserve historical architecture and history dates.
Replace obsolete Tasmanian upper-house source; distinguish completed Rosevears count from an unverified later ceremony. Future rule-derived dates do not become confirmed election timetables.

Retained separately reviewed six-council corrections and nomination-stage changes are documented in their own report; they are not nationwide officeholder certification or proof of publication approval.
1,522 contract visible-date expectations now match each route’s registered implementation date; 558 retain 23 October. No source-check date is inferred from a contract run.

gaps: All routes are inventoried, but not every factual assertion, officeholder, candidate, boundary, legislative provision or source link has been independently reverified.
1,339 place source records are inventoried with retained check dates; listing a source does not mean it was fetched again. Individual roster and deeper civic-journey gaps remain in place records.
985 extracted candidate statements include proposals, satire, historical statements and empirical assertions; they are not 985 verified facts. See per-page and claim-level evidence.
115 baseline routes lacked registered implementation dates. Unknown dates remain unknown except where a named historical implementation record or this actual edit supports a scoped date.
QLD and WA parliamentary roster access was blocked; complete current chamber recounts were not established in this pass.

QLD future dates found on an ECQ-labelled social account lacked completed first-party identity authentication; WA and NT future timetable evidence also remains incomplete. Statutory cycles are not newly announced polls.
State histories, all constitutional/legal claims, Victorian eligibility/donation rules, and all custom directory counts were not freshly reverified.
No clinical validation, medical efficacy, funded programme, partnership, approved hardware or operating financial product is inferred from original proposals.

Treaty participation must be checked instrument by instrument; the 1999 count is explicitly unverified. Exact historical $600 million Gabba enhancement cost lacks government primary confirmation in the bounded search.
Historical sighting/archive descriptions, remaining housing and fiscal statistics, and other page-specific source gaps remain in the non-place register.
Homepage Strange But True operational L1 claim was not independently substantiated by this policy-source pass; linked project descriptions and demonstrations do not establish all operational claims.
No exact deployed revision or live bytes for this combined audit have yet been verified. Local preparation and passing checks are not publication.

validation.combinedFinalAcceptance: Passed stated structural/runtime suites and all 2,081 registered contracts; actual browser scope retained separately. Not complete factual certification.

publication.note: This audit is authorised preparation, not proof of a pushed or deployed revision. Exact publication evidence is recorded separately after successful deployment and live checks.

reporting.scheduling: This report does not create a scheduled review.
